name: tabular_automl_search
title: A hand-rolled AutoML sweep: one matrix scaled and feature-selected once, then five bare estimators cross-validated over it
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-tabular: the AutoML-loop shape, and the cross-function leak that MLV101's same-scope walk cannot see

expected.defect: the scaler is fitted on the whole matrix in build_matrix(), which refit_best() later splits at line 68
expected.why: the holdout's means and variances are inside the training features, and the sweep that chooses the winner runs on the same matrix

expected.defect: SelectKBest is fitted on the whole matrix **with the labels**, before any split exists
expected.why: the surviving columns were chosen by an F-test that read the held-out labels, so the feature set itself is a function of the test set - a stronger leak than the scaler above it

expected.defect: every estimator in the sweep is passed bare to cross_val_score over a matrix that was scaled and feature-selected outside the loop
expected.why: no fold refits either step, so the whole leaderboard is ranked on inflated numbers and the ranking itself can change

forbidden.why: nothing is fitted on test_x: the two fits happen before any split exists, which is MLV101's defect and not MLV102's
there is no timestamp in this project - no parse_dates, no to_datetime, no date-named sort
every estimator, the splitter and the fold generator all carry random_state=SEED
train_test_split and StratifiedKFold both pass random_state=SEED
the only metric is roc_auc_score, which is in the score-metric carve-out
roc_auc_score is given best.predict_proba(test_x)[:, 1], a score column and not a hard label
there is no torch in this project

notes: MLV117 (train_test_split without stratify=) is catalogued but not implemented, so it cannot carry a forbidden label; for the record, in search.py: the split passes stratify=labels at line 69
